page.title: Connect to a Meshtastic device
page.description: Add a device connection via HTTP, Bluetooth, or Serial. Your saved connections will be saved in your browser.

areYouSure: This will remove {{name}}. You canot undo this action.

noConnections.title: No connections yet.
noConnections.description: Create your first connection. It will connect immediately and be saved for later.

renameDescription: Enter a new name for this connection.

editConnection.title: Edit Connection
editConnection.description: Modify the settings for this connection.

toasts.checkConnection: Check your device or settings and try again
toasts.pickConnectionAgain: Could not connect. You may need to reselect the device/port.
toasts.savedCantConnect: The connection was saved but could not connect.
toasts.firmwareOutdatedDescription: This radio runs firmware {{version}}. Some features need {{minimum}} or newer.
toasts.storageUnavailableDescription: The browser couldn't open the app's storage, so messages from this session will be gone after a reload. This can happen in a private window, or with the app open in other tabs.

overlay.stuckHint: Taking longer than usual. The device may be in CLI / bootloader mode, or the firmware isn't responding to config requests.

errors.certNotTrusted: Self-signed certificate not trusted. Open {{url}} in a new tab, accept the security warning, then return here and try again.
errors.httpsNotReachable: HTTPS endpoint not reachable. Check that the device is online.
errors.httpNotReachable: HTTP endpoint not reachable (may be blocked by CORS or a network issue)
errors.firmwareTooOld: Firmware {{version}} is too old for the web client. Update the radio to {{minimum}} or newer.

httpTest.certNotTrusted: Certificate not trusted. <0>Open in new tab</0> and accept the warning, then test again.

certGuide.title: Your browser doesn't trust this radio's certificate yet
certGuide.description: Radios use a self-signed certificate. Accept it once and your browser remembers it for this radio; you don't need to install anything.

firefox: On the warning page, click Advanced…
Click Accept the Risk and Continue.
Come back to this tab. The connection is checked again automatically.
safari: On the warning page, click Show Details.
Click visit this website, then Visit Website, and enter your Mac password if asked.
Come back to this tab. The connection is checked again automatically.
chromium: On the warning page, click Advanced.
Click Proceed to the radio's address (unsafe).
Come back to this tab. The connection is checked again automatically.

certGuide.waiting: Waiting for you to accept the certificate…
certGuide.timedOut: Still not trusted. Open the radio again and accept the warning.
certGuide.trusted: Certificate accepted. The radio is reachable.
